newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-JUVENTUS SIX POINTS CLEAR IN SERIE A.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS SIX POINTS CLEAR IN SERIE A.

text.p: Juventus had Uruguayan defender Paolo Montero sent off against Napoli on Sunday but held on for a 0-0 draw.
Second-placed Parma crashed 1-0 at Fiorentina, leaving Juventus with a commanding six-point lead in serie A.
Montero was shown the red card in the 37th minute for a foul that denied Nicola Caccia a clear run at goal. But Angelo Peruzzi's goalkeeping spared Juve from defeat and earned them the point.
Parma's run of four successive wins was ended when French defender Lilian Thuram deflected Rui Costa's shot past his own keeper Gian Luigi Buffon in the 33rd minute.

That result boosted third-placed Internazionale's hopes of qualifying for next season's European Cup. Roy Hodgson's team trailed Parma by just two points following a hard-fought 2-1 home victory over Verona.
